sources.title: GroundSignal synthetic radiology-report fixtures
sources.version_note: Synthetic report text is the frozen source of truth for report-faithfulness evaluation; it is not a clinical guideline.

claims.paraphrased_claim: The base report describes a 1.2 cm liver lesion as indeterminate and recommends MRI for further characterization.
The controlled benign fixture describes a simple cyst and explicitly says no further imaging is recommended for that finding.
The comparison fixture says the lesion is unchanged from a prior examination; stability is an observation, not a diagnosis of benignity unless the report says so.
The held-out fixture uses 'cannot exclude' wording and recommends follow-up CT; this preserves uncertainty rather than confirming the excluded possibility.
